issues: Covers fell to 2,187, down 277 (11.24%) week on week.
Spend per head rose to £24.58, up £1.19 (5.08%) week on week, though the GM/HC notes say SPH was dragged down by £5 ramen and FOH will work on getting it back up.
Sales were £53,839.86, down £2,995.49 (5.27%) week on week.
Sales missed the £60,637.50 target by £6,797.64 (11.21%), the second week running below target (-6.11% the week before), and this was not raised on the BOH call.
It was another quiet but strong weekend, the GM believes targets should be revised for low footfall periods, and sales are expected to pick up mid to late October.
Labour was 21.18%, the highest in the region, and there was no sheet in the rota for 28/09.
Food cost was 21.80%.
Food variance was -7.1% due to issues with chicken stock and prawns, drinks variance -0.9% and overall -6.1%.
Deliveroo late prepared orders and prepared time are both down, and disputed items were won.
Google reviews were all 5 star (10 reviews) on the BOH meeting dashboard.
FOH need to double check tickets so orders do not go to the wrong tables.
Kitchen cleanliness and FOH and BOH date labelling need improving, and kitchen staff need the compliance app so compliance does not all fall on one person.
Staff are still using cucumber instead of kale on sashimi, and Penny saw cooked ramen being held and re-dunked in hot water on her last visit.
A wok burner is loose and needs logging so Ross can send someone.
The fire panel is being serviced on 08/10.
Pest control, fire, electrical, gas and ventilation compliance are complete.
A new BOH team member was hired to start on Wednesday, and a new hot kitchen hire has signed.
Two team members are learning sushi well, two are training in Glasgow this week, and five staff can make sushi but need time to reach standard.
The site is still searching for a KS and wants one more sushi chef and a supervisor before Christmas.
XOXO, lunch and the app are the upcoming promotions.

Region-wide (Scotland BOH meeting 06/10): last week's chicken broth usage discrepancy was traced to a takeaway recipe still linked to the old tonkotsu broth in stock counts, which has been corrected, so usage should return to normal next week.

Region-wide (Scotland BOH meeting 06/10): Bidfood is being brought in as a new supplier, starting with Aberdeen and reaching the other sites within one to two months, and new beef samples are being trialled with a view to pre-cooked beef so sites no longer cook it themselves.

Region-wide (Scotland BOH meeting 06/10): frozen ramen promotion stock is delivered from the factory on 07/10, but storage space at the smaller sites is unconfirmed and the memo does not specify quantities per flavour.
